name: Jonatan Etzler
bio: Jonatan Karl Martin Etzler, born on March 13, 1988, is a Swedish director and screenwriter. He trained in film directing at the Stockholm Academy of Dramatic Arts.

credits.title: Bad Apples
credits.overview: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.

credits.title: One More Time
credits.overview: On her 40th birthday, Amelia makes a fateful wish to be 18 again back in 2002 but soon regrets it when she's stuck reliving the day over and over again.

credits.title: Animal Food
credits.overview: A dark comedy about a socially awkward man with an abnormal interest in bird food. What’s cultural acceptable to eat, and what’s not? The story is told using rhythmic visuals, without dialogue.

credits.title: Swimmer
credits.overview: A car belonging to a suspected hit-and-run driver has been spotted outside a swimming pool complex and the police are there to arrest the fugitive.

credits.title: Iranian Kiss
credits.overview: During a film shoot in Tehran the director is trying to film a romantic scene but the government censor keeps interrupting and getting involved.

credits.title: The Stick
credits.overview: An applicant. A jury. The most prestigious film school. An admission test where you balance a stick on your finger.

credits.title: Get Ready with Me
credits.overview: Aspiring youtuber Vendela decides to get up infront of her high school class and show a disturbing video that disrupts the lesson and causes her teacher Lukas to fear for her life. credits.title: Intercourse
credits.overview: A couple wakes up in bed together; they start making out and he wants to take things further, but she’s not in the mood. A passing joke about paying for her to change her mind turns serious and afterwards, they have a hard time coming to terms with how this has changed their relationship.

credits.title: Make a Wish
credits.overview: Anita and Gunnar live a calm, retired life. They don’t make love anymore. They watch TV. When Anita makes a wish and is visited by a young, virile TV show host, the couple is suddenly faced with life-changing events. Make a Wish is a comedy about dreams, and about what happens when you get too much of a good thing.

credits.title: The Less Fortunate
credits.overview: A 10-year-old girl discovers that her privileged life may have something to do with the reason she doesn’t have any siblings.

credits.title: Grownups
credits.overview: Johanna is sitting on the floor at the party. Her friends have something to say. They feel that they don’t need her as a friend anymore. Besides, she wasn’t invited to the party.

credits.title: I Follow You
credits.overview: Anna bumps into Jesper on the morning train. She’s never seen him before, but it turns out he knows everything about her.  A short film about social media and surveillance in postmodern society.

credits.title: Åka utför
credits.overview: Elin is 8 years old when she realizes that children are divided into richer and poorer. She tries to fit in at her new school where the children go on vacation to skiing resorts instead of staying home. A short film based on a true story.

credits.title: An Awful Lot of Money
credits.overview: Livia watches her life fall apart before her eyes. When she's reached the absolute bottom she remembers what her father told her as a child: 'As long as you have money you are happy. As long as you have an awful, awful lot of money.' She sets out to pursue happiness by acquiring an awful lot of money.

credits.title: The World That Once Was Mine
credits.overview: As a young boy in the 1920s, Carl Schönmeyr was regularly filmed by his mother. The result was unique footage of a bygone world. Carl comments on the pictures at the end of his life with a nostalgic look.

credits.title: The Ballad of Beatrice
credits.overview: A surrealistic musical about the love between a woman and a talking photocopier in a patriarchal slave society. Beatrice is one of many women who work hard under the unfair boss, Mr Kättström.
